item.title: Shito Tenshi Angel Liebe
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mad Script
  • 発売日: 2017-04-09
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 使徒天使エンジェルリーベ
  • 英語名: Shito Tenshi Angel Liebe

别名

  • Apostle Angel Liebe

あらすじ

The story revolves around angels, Shank and Pyure, who, due to their insufficient power, decide to empower talented individuals to combat devils. While searching for suitable candidates, they encounter ordinary students, Sakura and Kaede, being attacked by devils. Shank transforms them into Apostle Angels, enabling them to successfully repel the devils. Subsequently, Sakura and Kaede continue to fight against the devils as Angel Liebe and Angel Arce.

item.title: Miisha Senki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mad Script
  • 発売日: 2012-11-06
  • スコア: 5.9799999999999995/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ミーシャ戦記
  • 英語名: Miisha Senki

别名

  • Record of Misha War

あらすじ

Misha, the princess of the Kingdom of Fisutania, has to escape from the clutches of the Vuareesu Empire, conquering her country. The prince of the Empire is relentlessly chasing after her however, doing anything to capture the princess. After some struggle, she ends up on a far away planet, with the prince on her tracks. Misha, and a small number of loyal companions have to try to stand against the army of the Vuareesu’s prince, avoiding capture at all cost…

item.title: Mahou Kishi Arishia
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mad Script
  • 発売日: 2011-08-11
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔法騎士アリシア
  • 英語名: Mahou Kishi Arishia

あらすじ

War has broken out in one of the kingdoms of the magical world, Rooran. The events forced a member of the royal family to flee to Earth. Now she has to try blending in the society here, while also hunting down her enemies whom have followed her to this world and planning a counter-attack, to return to her home.
